question: CELLFORMER4.md sec 6 / criterion 2 -- does a simple set encoder match the transformer? Arms 6-8 of sec 6's mandatory control list, never previously run.

task.data: gwps.h5ad dense K562 pseudobulk logFC, 100% density (NOT the nlz_* benches, which are 3.5% dense and whose zeros mean NOT RECORDED)
task.target: S = |z| - per-gene mean |z| over TRAINING knockouts, refit per partition
task.secondary_metric: threshold-free cosine to the centred profile

parameter_budget.note: hidden widths bisected so every learned arm lands on the Set Transformer's count; arm 5 carries 33,024 q/k parameters that receive no gradient when the attention matrix is frozen, so it is DEPTH-matched and total-parameter-matched but not effective-parameter-matched

unit_of_replication: a DISJOINT KNOCKOUT PARTITION. The per_seed lists above hold one value per held-out partition (n = 3), NOT model-init seeds.
controls_reproducing_the_effect_note: these are fractions of arm 4's raw gain over self-only. If the denominator is itself below the MDE the ratios are meaningless and the flag above is false.
circularity_check: token features are DepMap CRISPR gene-effect PCs and the co-dependency edges are DepMap-derived; the scored target is Replogle Perturb-seq K562 transcriptomics. No feature is scored on the dataset it derives from. All target-side statistics (centring, truth sets, evidence prior) are refit on the training partition inside every fold.
limits: n = 3 partitions gives the sd 2 degrees of freedom, so the MDE is itself poorly estimated and a gap just under it is not evidence of equality. Raising V4_FOLDS is the cheapest way to falsify or confirm a near-threshold call

a null here is a null for THIS encoder at THIS budget on THIS retrieval objective (Gram matching on centred |z| profiles). A deeper stack, more heads, or a contrastive objective could still separate the arms; what is falsified is the claim as currently made, that the single attention block in Block 3 is doing work a mean-pool cannot

at most 24 tokens and at most 7 partners per relation type. Attention has more to do on large sets than small ones, so this is a conservative regime FOR the mean-pool arms and the result should not be extrapolated to a wider partner set without rerunning

arm 5 keeps its q and k parameters but they receive no gradient, so it has fewer EFFECTIVE parameters than arm 4. That biases the comparison in the transformer's favour: if arm 4 beats arm 5, the cause is ambiguous between attention and those parameters, whereas if arm 4 does NOT beat arm 5 the conclusion that attention adds nothing is strengthened

the tide definition and the mover frequency that the TIDE-null floor ranks by are computed over all knockouts including the held-out ones, inherited unchanged from dense_stage1 so the numbers stay comparable. It is a leak shared identically by every arm and it flatters the floor arm most
K562 only, one assay, one time point. Nothing here speaks to whether an attention layer is needed once cell context, dose or time enter the token set

the retrieval head is a nearest-neighbour copier, so every arm is capped by the dense ORACLE (0.0526 in dense_stage1). Encoders can only be separated up to that ceiling and differences compress against it

the evidence prior for arm 2 is estimated only from partners that are themselves knockouts in the screen, which is a biased subset of partners, and it is a single scalar per relation type -- a richer prior is a different arm and was not run
verdict: SMOKE RUN (800 knockouts, 3 epochs) -- THIS IS A PLUMBING CHECK AND NOT A RESULT. Every arm sits within noise of the 0.0061 random floor at this size, the encoders cannot be separated, and no sentence below should be quoted as a finding. Rerun with V4_SMOKE unset. CRITERION 2 FAILS: on the dense untruncated K562 target (800 knockouts, 8,175 genes, 100% density) with the task, target, metric and retrieval held identical to dense_stage1 and ONLY the encoder varying at a matched budget of 108,160 parameters, the Set Transformer reaches recall@50 0.0100 while the best simple set encoder ('1 unweighted mean-pool') reaches 0.0098 -- a gap of +0.0002 against a cross-partition minimum detectable increment of 0.0014 (3*sd/sqrt(n), n = 3 DISJOINT KNOCKOUT PARTITIONS; the model-init-seed floor of 0.0016 measures optimiser noise inside one partition and is deliberately NOT what this is graded on). CELLFORMER4.md section 6 retains the transformer only if it beats simpler set encoders, so on this evidence Block 3 should be reimplemented as a mean-pool over typed partner tokens: the validated object is a BAG OF TYPED PARTNERS, not a transformer. THE SHARP ARM separates attention from depth: freezing the attention matrix to a uniform 1/n inside the identical module changes recall by +0.0008, so the attention PATTERN is not detected -- whatever arm 4 has over a plain mean-pool is depth and parameters, not content-based weighting. THE CHEAPEST NON-LEARNED ARM, a zero-parameter cosine retrieval on raw DepMap vectors, scores 0.0092 ('B raw DepMap bag-of-partners (0 param)'), i.e. +0.0007 below the transformer -- A TRIVIAL BASELINE WITH NO PARAMETERS MATCHES OR BEATS THE MODEL, which is the headline and not a footnote. Attribution of the neighbourhood itself: real vs uniformly random partners +0.0017, real vs a DEGREE-MATCHED configuration-model rewiring +0.0014, and the counterfactual test in which the trained network is handed another held-out knockout's neighbours +0.0026 -- a swap gap at or below the MDE would mean the neighbourhood channel is IGNORED rather than useless, which accuracy alone cannot distinguish. The threshold-free cosine metric AGREES with recall@50 on the primary gap (+0.0030 against a 0.0262 cosine MDE). All effect sizes quoted here are RAW held-out values; the control arms establish significance and attribution and nothing is reported net of a control.
